method: Independent detector adaptive interval quadrature with forward NESTED integer-floor interval classifier; no inverse HPX chart code
qualification: Interval enclosure for normalized ICRS TAN+SIP coefficients, assuming mpmath.iv arithmetic and transcendental enclosures. External WCSLIB/HEALPix occurs only in iid/finite-difference validation. IID confidence is simultaneous per fixture only. Historical external-cone bounds were falsified and are retained separately.
